Why now

Shoppers are starting to ask AI before they search.

AI assistants now answer product questions with a short, ranked list. The traffic is still small, but it’s growing fast and converting well, and most brands have no idea whether their products are on that list.

FAQ

Good questions, straight answers.

Something else on your mind? Bring it to your demo.

● produkто / ask
Which AI assistant do you measure?

Produkto tracks answers from ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity. The dashboard lets you explore each engine separately.

How do I improve my visibility?

Start with Opportunities: the questions you lose, the sites AI cites that don’t mention you, and the details winning product pages state that yours don’t. Whether a specific change moves your numbers is something we measure on the same questions, not something we promise.

Do you need access to my Shopify store?

No. We read your public product feed and pages. There’s no login, no app to install, and nothing on your store is changed.

Is the dashboard on this page real?

It’s a simplified illustration of the Produkto dashboard. The brands are examples and the numbers are illustrative, not measured results. Before your demo we scan your own store, so on the call you see the real dashboard with your products.
